<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  An email sign-up: heading, one sentence, an email field and a button, with an optional consent line and
  picture. Axes: layout (inline, stacked, split), terms (show, hide), tone (default, muted), align (start,
  center).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type NewsletterFormProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  label: string;
  submit: string;
  consent?: string;
  layout?: "inline" | "stacked" | "split";
  terms?: "show" | "hide";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  align?: "start" | "center";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Form from "../compose/Form.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Input from "../compose/Input.vue";
import Label from "../compose/Label.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  label,
  submit,
  consent,
  layout = "inline",
  terms = "hide",
  tone = "default",
  align = "center",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<NewsletterFormProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="text"
    :tone="tone"
    :align="align"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :media="{ show: ((layout as string) === 'split') }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Form
      method="dialog"
      :class="cn('w-full max-w-md', (((align as string) === 'center') ? 'mx-auto' : ''))"
      data-slot="newsletter-form"
    >
      <Label :for="tpl('{0}-email', id)" class="sr-only">
        {{ label }}
      </Label>
      <Group
        gap="2"
        align="start"
        :class="cn('w-full', (((layout as string) === 'stacked') ? 'flex-col items-stretch' : 'flex-wrap'))"
      >
        <Input type="email" name="email" class="min-w-0 flex-1" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-slot="field" />
        <Button variant="default" size="default" type="submit">
          {{ submit }}
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <Text
        v-if="(((terms as string) === 'show') && consent)"
        size="xs"
        class="text-muted-foreground"
        data-slot="consent"
      >
        {{ consent }}
      </Text>
    </Form>
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
